In this video:
🔹 Facebook Marketplace axolotl rescue
🔹 Full quarantine & recovery process
🔹 Limb regeneration up close
🔹 Massive new axolotl tank build
🔹 Feeding live worms (macro footage)

If you love aquarium rescues, exotic pet rehab, and amphibian care content, this ones for you!
